colors.name: Void Indigo
colors.role: Page background, primary surface - near-black with a violet undertone that makes the whole canvas feel tinted rather than neutral

colors.name: Abyss Plum
colors.role: Elevated card surface, shadow tone - a step lighter than Void Indigo, used to lift cards off the canvas with violet ambient

colors.name: Onyx
colors.role: Deep contrast surface for cards, input fills, and the darkest band behind photo content

colors.name: Glacier
colors.role: Off-white section backgrounds, light card surfaces - cool-tinted to harmonize with the violet system

colors.name: Paper
colors.role: Primary text on dark surfaces, button labels, image overlays - the dominant non-background color in the system

colors.name: Ash
colors.role: Tertiary text and subtle borders on light sections

colors.name: Graphite
colors.role: Image borders, input strokes, secondary link text on light surfaces

colors.name: Charcoal
colors.role: Button borders on light surfaces, heavy text emphasis

colors.name: Pulse Blue
colors.role: Primary filled action background (CTA buttons, active nav) - the only chromatic fill in the system, acts as the single notification LED against the dark canvas

colors.name: Iris
colors.role: Outlined action border, secondary accent - the violet identity color applied to ghost buttons and decorative strokes

colors.name: Lavender Lightning
colors.role: Outlined action border, gradient start - lighter violet for tertiary buttons and gradient origins

colors.name: Neon Sprout
colors.role: Link borders, icon borders, active state highlights - vivid green used sparingly as functional punctuation on links and tags

colors.name: Dusk Fade
colors.role: Gradient mid-stop - deep violet that bridges bright lavender to black in hero gradient washes

fonts.name: Avenir
fonts.role: Primary typeface across all contexts - headings, body, navigation, buttons, cards. Light 300 for large display headings creates a soft documentary feel; bold 700 for buttons and tag labels; regular 400 for body and supporting text.

fonts.name: Poppins
fonts.role: Rare single-use bold label - appears on one decorative badge/button context, providing a geometric contrast to Avenir's humanist curves

components.name: Primary Filled Button
components.role: Main conversion action - donations, sign-ups, primary CTAs

components.name: Outlined Action Button
components.role: Secondary conversion - ghost CTAs on dark and light sections

components.name: Navigation Pill Button
components.role: Header CTA - the persistent 'Donate' action in the top nav

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.role: Sticky site header with brand, dropdown nav, and CTA

components.name: Photo Collage Grid
components.role: Decorative youth imagery on hero and section right sides

components.name: Gradient Feature Card
components.role: Highlighted content section with light-violet background

components.name: App Mockup Display
components.role: Product visual showing the Promly app interface

components.name: Credential/Award Row
components.role: Social proof - awards, recognitions, media features

components.name: Event Feature Section
components.role: Immersive content section - concerts, festivals, events

components.name: Footer
components.role: Site footer (implied, not fully visible in screenshots)

components.name: Input Field
components.role: Form inputs for newsletter, contact, or app signup

components.name: Highlight Link
components.role: In-body links that need to stand out on dark backgrounds

do: Use the Hero Dusk gradient (linear-gradient(216deg, #a755fb 20%, #47246a 37%, #000000 90%)) as the only hero background - never substitute a flat color or a different gradient angle.
Apply 20px border-radius to all documentary photos and 30px to larger featured crops; 12px to all buttons and inputs; 25px to section cards.
Set headlines at 60px Avenir weight 300 with -4px letter-spacing - the light weight is the signature, not bold.
Use Pulse Blue (#3898ec) filled buttons for the single primary action per screen; Iris (#755eff) outlined buttons for secondary actions.
Anchor each hero with a right-side photo collage of 8-10 rounded images with 1px white borders, arranged in offset rows.
Let the violet-tinted shadow (rgba(102, 77, 255, 0.2) 0px 4px 100px) be the only elevation effect on cards - no gray drop shadows.
Set section gap to 80px and card padding to 20px as the structural rhythm baseline.
doNot: Do not use bold (700) or extra-bold weights for display headings - weight 300 is the system's identity choice; bold headlines break the whisper-tone.
Do not introduce new colors for action buttons - the system has exactly one filled chromatic action (Pulse Blue) and outlined actions must use Iris, Lavender Lightning, or Neon Sprout.
Do not apply flat black (#000000) as the page background - Void Indigo (#040723) is the system canvas; pure black is reserved for deepest card surfaces only.
Do not use sharp corners (0px radius) on any image or card - every visual element must carry at least 8px radius, most 12-20px.
Do not place green on filled buttons or backgrounds - Neon Sprout (#0be014) is link-border and icon-border only.
Do not stack shadows or use gray-toned drop shadows - the single violet glow shadow is the only allowed elevation effect.
Do not alternate text alignment arbitrarily - heroes are consistently left-aligned text with right-side photo collage; do not center-align long-form content.
